note: Re-judged 2026-10-21 (independent judge, over the uncommitted errChildEncapPort change for plan/immediate/spec-ike-eap-rfc-defects.md). Section 5.1: "If the SPD entry calls for PROTECT, i.e., creation of an SA, the key management mechanism (e.g., IKEv2) is invoked to create the SA." installChildSA changed in one place only: before anything is installed it refuses a Child SA with UDPEncap set and a zero udpLocalPort or udpRemotePort (errChildEncapPort). That narrows which negotiated SAs install; it adds no path from an outbound packet to IKEv2. PROTECT entries are still installed only beside a Child SA IKEv2 already negotiated, and no XFRM acquire is handled under internal/component/ike (the non-test 'acquire' hits are a netlink receiver comment, redistevents.AcquireBatch and a lock comment). {gap} text at rfc/short/rfc4301.md:540 remains accurate. Gap stands.
